India vs England ODI: Key Player Bumrah Out of Third Match

Jasprit Bumrah will not be playing in the third ODI match between India and England at Lord's. The Indian team has made three changes to its playing eleven for the match. Kuldeep Yadav is also mentioned as having disappointed.
